collector: AI-assisted official HTML reading and one official-image visual inspection

records.academicNote: Bachelor/equivalent, OR at least seven years in journalism or a related profession assessed as degree-equivalent with academic aptitude. Seven years is NOT a universal bachelor-applicant gate. Shortlisted applicants are interviewed. Submit a 500-word English self-statement OR an English journalism/research/similar work sample. International Journalism and Business/Financial Journalism are concentrations of one MA, not additional awards.

An honours bachelor is required; no specific honours class or numeric GPA is published. Professional experience is preferred, not a mandatory work-year minimum. A 500-word English essay is required; publication/research sample is requested if available. Interview is selective. Post-entry scholarships and PGD exit CGPA 2.50 are not undergraduate entry criteria.

Putonghua EMBA: two-year full-time block format, two to four days per month in Hong Kong. Bachelor/equivalent professional qualification requires at least six post-qualification work years; Benke route requires ten years including three in senior managerial/professional work; other listed qualifications require twelve years including three senior/professional years. The six-year automatic lower bound does not establish the correct ten/twelve-year branch or work timing/role. Satisfactory admissions interview is required. The programme website expressly states no compulsory English or GMAT/GRE requirement. Marketing visa/career claims are not treated as an entitlement.

Normal route: second-class honours or above in Chinese or a related subject such as mass media, humanities, cultural studies or education. An ordinary/general degree plus relevant work, OR an assessed equivalent qualification, is an alternative; no fixed work years or universal second-class gate is imposed. Teaching uses Cantonese and Putonghua. No numeric Chinese test or programme-specific English threshold is established in the read body; proficiency/applicability remains assessed.

Normally at least second-class bachelor/equivalent; recognition and alternative qualifications remain assessed. Both English AND Chinese speaking/listening/writing competence are required; Cantonese is not required. English alternatives include IELTS 6.0, old TOEFL 79, CET-6 500, HKALE/HKDSE or an English-medium bachelor. Chinese alternatives include HKALE D, HKDSE 4, specified IB grades, SHSK Level 2, HSK VI total 240, Chinese-medium bachelor or the departmental test. Submit a 12–15-page creative sample containing English and Chinese work plus a one-page Master Project proposal in either language. English score satisfaction does not waive Chinese or portfolio evidence.

Recognised bachelor/equivalent; no exclusive major, numeric GPA or fixed work-year criterion is established. IELTS 6.0, old TOEFL 74 or CET-6 450 is listed for non-English-medium entrants. The elective/dissertation streams are alternatives within one taught MA. Total HKD 160,000; PT instalments HKD 106,680 plus HKD 53,320 are not annual multipliers or additional fees.

Bachelor in ANY discipline/equivalent. IELTS 6.0, old TOEFL 79 or CET-6 480 is published. Interview may be required and rolling/quota closure may precede the final dates. Global Cultures, Global Political Economy and Global Social Development are concentrations, not extra awards.

Bachelor/equivalent; mature applicants lacking standard qualifications may be considered case by case. Advanced spoken/written English is expected; other languages including Chinese are advantageous, not mandatory. IELTS 6.0, old TOEFL 79, CET-6 500 or listed HKALE/HKDSE qualifications. The eight-year/B-minus rule concerns credit transfer, not English-score validity or entry GPA. Transfer and any adjusted fee require approval; no automatic discount or teacher registration is claimed.

Ordinary taught MALCS only: BA/equivalent, with mature/non-standard applicants assessed individually, possibly by qualifying examination. IELTS 6.0 or old TOEFL 79/listed school qualifications plus advanced English. The central funding/teaching-language labels are visibly swapped; the department explicitly confirms English teaching. Optional University of Melbourne further-study double degree is excluded from this ordinary offer: its undergraduate and completed-MA 3.0/4.0, IELTS 6.5/6.0 each and second-institution fees are NOT ordinary MALCS requirements. Graduation/PGD CGPA 2.5 is not undergraduate entry GPA.

Music bachelor with at least second-class honours or assessed equivalent. Recognition, equivalence and any interview remain assessed. The source states IELTS 6.0 or old TOEFL 74 specifically for NON-LOCAL applicants with a non-English-medium bachelor. Because applicability depends on institution-decided classification, this conditional score route is manual; it is not a universal English failure gate or an automatic local exemption.

Recognised bachelor/equivalent. IELTS 6.5 or old TOEFL 79 for non-English-medium graduates. Submit a 500-word paper on interests and present understanding of the field; publication/research output only where relevant/available. No required prior media major or fixed work years is inferred.

Bachelor/equivalent professional qualification. ALL streams publish IELTS 6.0, old TOEFL 79 or CET-6 500/listed school qualifications, plus advanced English. Interpreting and Practical require advanced Chinese (Putonghua OR Cantonese) and accepted Chinese evidence. Technology requires another advanced language besides English, which need NOT be Chinese; if Chinese, the same Chinese evidence applies. Two references and transcripts are required. English and Chinese 300-word statements are required except Technology does NOT require the Chinese statement. Stream-specific evidence remains assessed, not imposed universally.

Bachelor/equivalent plus relevant studio-practice experience; no fixed years or exclusive art degree is stated. Submit 5–10 images of original artworks, declare Studio & Media Arts OR Craft & Design, and provide the concentration-specific study proposal. IELTS 6.5, old TOEFL 79, CET-6 450 or English-medium evidence. The headline 31 December 2026 is ROUND 1, not the final date: Round 2 is 23 April 2027 and a 15 July 2027 clearing round is LOCAL ONLY. Interview dates are not application cutoffs.

Chinese Medicine/Chinese Pharmacy bachelor/equivalent, OR a Hong Kong registered practitioner via the licensing examination, OR another registered-practitioner route with training evidence and assessment. These are alternatives, not automatic professional registration. Accepted Chinese-medium bachelor, HKDSE Chinese 3, HKALE Chinese E or School Chinese test evidence is required; basic computing skills are also stated. The current department 2027/28 page corroborates September 2027, total HKD 156,000 and 2 October 2026–2 March 2027 applications, superseding the central page conflicting 2026 entry/deadline labels. Part-time is LOCAL ONLY. Practicum may use HKBU clinics AND/OR mainland hospitals; a guaranteed all-Hong-Kong path is unconfirmed. CGPA 2.5 is graduation, not entry.

Bachelor/equivalent AND postgraduate education certificate/diploma or equivalent AND/OR relevant professional work with children/adolescents. No fixed work-year minimum is stated. IELTS 6.0 or assessed equivalent for non-English-medium graduates; a numeric TOEFL threshold is not published in the read programme body. Current listed concentrations are Child/Adolescent Development and English Language for Teaching; the five names in a 2018/19 scholarship note do not establish five current options. FT final 30 November 2026 and PT final 31 January 2027 are MODE-specific, not local/non-local dates.

Current two-year, 48-unit MFA in Cinematic Arts and Creative Practice, replacing the older three-year programme; no extra legacy award is added. Bachelor/equivalent plus academic aptitude and creative interest. Normal language route IELTS 6.5, old TOEFL 79 or CET-6 450. Applicants with relevant talent and IELTS 6.0/equivalent MAY be considered subject to satisfactory English enhancement; an automated 6.0 lower-bound comparison is not unconditional normal-route satisfaction. HKD 436,000 is the whole two-year total.

Chinese Medicine/Chinese Pharmacy degree/equivalent, named related science/medical degrees, Hong Kong pharmacist/registered Chinese medicine practitioner, OR professional-diploma route with relevant work. Central wording says MORE THAN three years for the diploma branch; department says THREE OR MORE: preserve the discrepancy for assessment, not a universal three-year gate. Chinese-medium bachelor, HKDSE Chinese 3, HKALE Chinese E or School Chinese test evidence and basic computing are required. Those without Chinese-medicine/pharmacy preparation may need the extra HKD 14,300 overview course. PT is LOCAL ONLY. Graduation CGPA 2.5 is not entry GPA.

Bachelor in ANY discipline/equivalent. A SPECIAL interview-consideration route for outstanding work plus NGO/public-sector/government recommendations mentions undergraduate cGPA 2.60, with no original scale specified. It is NOT a universal 2.60/4.0 cutoff; no automatic GPA gate or conversion is created. IELTS 6.0, old TOEFL 79 or CET-6 450. Qualified applicants may be interviewed.

Chinese Medicine, Pharmacy or Chinese Pharmacy bachelor/equivalent; related Life Sciences, Bioengineering and Information Science/Technology may be assessed. Hong Kong pharmacists/registered practitioners with a bachelor are another route; non-degree registered practitioners may be considered case by case. Chinese-medium bachelor, HKDSE Chinese 3, HKALE Chinese E or School Chinese test and basic computing are required. Those without Chinese-medicine/pharmacy preparation may need the extra HKD 14,300 overview course. PT is LOCAL ONLY. Dissertation is optional against a taught elective; this is not a research-master exclusion. CGPA 2.5 is graduation, not entry.

A good bachelor with relevant healthcare registration, Chinese Medicine/Chinese Pharmacy bachelor, another approved bachelor discipline, OR a registered-practitioner examination route may qualify. Healthcare registration is NOT imposed on every bachelor route. Accepted Chinese-medium bachelor, HKDSE Chinese 3, HKALE Chinese E or School Chinese test and basic computing are required. Extra HKD 14,300 overview course applies where background requires it, without automatic scholarship/alumni discount. PT is LOCAL ONLY. Required observation/practicum arrangements need confirmation; graduation CGPA 2.5 is not entry GPA.

Bachelor/equivalent; social-science/humanities background is PREFERRED, not compulsory. The page explicitly states no interviews. English alternatives include Hong Kong/English-speaking-country bachelor evidence, IELTS 6.0, old TOEFL 79 or CET-6 450; recognition and waiver acceptance remain assessed. The heading says four concentrations but enumerates only three; no fourth or extra degree is invented.

Bachelor/equivalent with preferably relevant people-facing experience and psychology/human-development/guidance preparation. Qualified applicants are interviewed. IELTS 6.0 or old TOEFL 74/equivalent. The 80-hour counselling practicum is post-entry training, not prior work. Central page labels September 2026 but displays 2026–2027 application dates and HKD 213,440 including practicum. The actual department-linked admissions image was visually read and explicitly says Admission 2027/28, corroborating a current cohort; it does NOT state the current fee or category deadlines. Because the central fee/date cohort binding remains unsettled, no actionable tuition/open/final date or applicant-price context is created. Three specialisations remain one taught degree; no independent clinical registration is promised.

Conversion programme for a NON-Psychology degree, defined by whether the first degree fully satisfies HKPS recognised-psychology membership criteria, NOT merely its title or count of psychology courses. An introductory psychology course is preferred. IELTS 6.0 or old TOEFL 79/English-medium evidence. January 2027 FT-only fee HKD 235,440 and 1–30 September 2026 window are separate from September 2027 FT/PT fee HKD 269,280 and 1 October–30 November 2026 window. The past January cutoff remains a historical date, not a new September round or recurring date. Admission does not automatically grant professional society membership.

Named bachelor fields include Geography, Urban Planning/Studies, Data Science, Geographic Information Science, Architecture, Landscape Planning and Public Policy, or related disciplines, with good performance (upper-second honours or equivalent professional qualification). The normal upper-second comparison does not confirm equivalence/professional alternatives. IELTS 6.0, old TOEFL 79 or CET-6 480/English-medium evidence. No numeric GPA is inferred.

Qualifying MSocSc in Social Work: recognised bachelor/equivalent; RSW based on a recognised social-work diploma OR undergraduate social-science background receives PRIORITY, not universal mandatory RSW entry. English-medium evidence and IELTS 6.0/old TOEFL 74/equivalent are listed; exact alternative wording needs documentary assessment. Mandatory interview and two field placements form part of this degree; the placements are included in FT HKD 366,940 / PT HKD 346,840 totals. Do not merge this two-year qualification with the separate one-year MSW or promise automatic registration.

Bachelor/equivalent; sport-related degree or work is PREFERRED, not an exclusive major or mandatory years. IELTS 6.0 OR old TOEFL total 74 AND Writing at least 21. New 1–6 TOEFL is expressly accepted for university assessment using the score report; no exact 1–6 cutoff is published, so no conversion is made. PT is LOCAL ONLY, unlike FT. Test validity is offer-letter-relative, not rolling from today.

Ordinary Hong Kong FULL-TIME one-year MSW only. The central page explicitly locates PART-TIME study at Zhuhai BNBU campus, so that out-of-region option is NOT offered as a Hong Kong/Singapore path. Social Work bachelor or related social-sciences/human-services equivalent; usually good second class, with outstanding work exceptions. Two relevant work years is PREFERRED, not mandatory. IELTS 6.0, old TOEFL 74, CET-6 450 or accepted equivalent. Do not inherit the two-year qualifying MSocSc curriculum or make a new parent for the excluded location.
